project_type: Roblox Luau pet simulator game (Battle Pets)
build_system: python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py generates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx from src/ tree
test_framework: No automated test suite - verification is via generate_rbxlx.py succeeding and Lua syntax checks
verification_instructions: Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py from project root and confirm it succeeds without errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is generated by tools/generate_rbxlx.py and checked in
setup_instructions: No special setup required - just python3 available
environment_constraints: No Roblox runtime available for live testing. Validate via generate_rbxlx.py and Luau syntax.
contribution_requirements: Server-authoritative architecture, no client-side exploits possible, all geometry procedurally generated via code, no external assets
key_patterns: Services pattern: init(dataService, ...) function, module table returned. RemoteFunctions created in Main.server.lua with rate limiting. UIController creates ScreenGuis procedurally. Config.lua holds constants. DataService caches player data in _cache[userId].
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/Services/ - server-side service modules; src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ - client scripts and controllers; src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared config and data modules; tools/ - build scripts
